item.title: Government scraps DWP benefit bank account plan, reports say
item.body: The UK Government has abandoned plans to check welfare claimants' bank accounts for fraud, according to reports. Chancellor John Healey scrapped the plan, which would have let Department for Work and Pensions officials see the savings of Universal Credit applicants.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📋 Government scraps DWP benefit bank account plan, reports say

The UK Government has abandoned plans to check welfare claimants' bank accounts for fraud, according to reports. Chancellor John Healey scrapped the plan, which would have let Department for Work and Pensions officials see the savings of Universal Credit applicants.

Source: Nation.Cymru / Press Associati | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 9 November, 09:50
